need: A local page that steps through one Claude or Codex session in order and shows, at each write, the edit hook's hand-over text, the requirement pages read, and the lockstep reads marks, with file versions when a recorder ran.

searched.query: session replay, transcript viewer, read before write
searched.found: The draft viewer (server, recorder, page) shows notes, tool calls and recorded file versions for claude -p stream files in a benchmark folder layout, but drops hand-over attachments and reads no Codex session; lockstep reads already computes the per-write marks for all four session formats; the graph viewer draws graphs, not timelines; capabilities.md lists no session viewer.

searched.where: GitHub search: claude code transcript viewer, claude code session replay, codex rollout viewer, claude-code-log, claude code jsonl viewer
searched.query: Claude Code and Codex session viewers
searched.found: daaain/claude-code-log (1274 stars) turns Claude transcripts into HTML or Markdown; ly4096x/ClaudeCodeTranscriptViewer and frederikberg/orbit show Claude transcripts in a browser; zhangfeiran/codex-rollout-viewer shows Codex rollouts. None reads both clients, none shows hook context as an event or any read-before-write relation, and none keeps file versions over time.

candidates.name: session-replay draft (2026-11-27)
candidates.covers: The page: timeline slider, event list, file tree with read and write dots, reading and writing panes with added lines, file versions from the recorder.
candidates.misses: Hand-overs, Codex, requirement reads, read marks; a fixed benchmark folder layout; not in git.
candidates.reason: Its page is kept nearly whole; the server is replaced by one that reads any session file and joins lockstep reads.

candidates.name: lockstep.read_before_write
candidates.covers: Reads and writes of all four session formats, hand-over detection, requirement context, the per-write marks.
candidates.misses: No display content (notes, results, edit text).
candidates.reason: The page takes its marks from report() joined by call id, so page and report cannot disagree.

candidates.name: daaain/claude-code-log
candidates.covers: Readable HTML of a Claude transcript.
candidates.misses: Codex, hook context as events, read marks, file versions, live follow.
candidates.reason: It would cover only the plain conversation, which the draft page already shows.

candidates.name: zhangfeiran/codex-rollout-viewer
candidates.misses: Claude, hand-overs, read marks, file versions; no stars, no record of upkeep.
candidates.reason: One client only and nothing Lockstep-specific.
